Class LogRecord

java.lang.Object
LogRecord
Direct Known Subclasses:
EncLogRecord, EndRecord, ErrorLogRecord, MsgLogRecord
public abstract class LogRecord extends Object
Represents one log entry with fields: type, timestamp, value, and payload. A log entry is stored in pipe format. This class is abstract because users should not create generic LogRecord objects. Instead, specific subclasses such as MsgLogRecord, EncLogRecord, and ErrorLogRecord must be created. All subclasses must implement the processPayload method.

  • Constructor Details

    • LogRecord

      public LogRecord(String rawLog)
      Parses a raw log string and stores its four parts. Each field is trimmed to remove extra spaces. Expected format: type|timestamp|value|payload
      Parameters:
      rawLog - the raw log entry string

    • LogRecord

      public LogRecord(String type, String ts, int value, String payload)
      Creates a log record from already parsed values. This constructor is mainly used by subclasses when they already know the field values.
      Parameters:
      type - log type
      ts - timestamp string
      value - integer value
      payload - payload text

  • Method Details

    • processPayload

      public abstract int processPayload()
      Abstract method that must be implemented by all subclasses. This method processes the payload based on the log type and returns an integer that determines which output file the processed log should be written to. Each subclass defines its own processing behavior.
      Returns:
      integer category (used to determine output file)

    • getLogString

      public String getLogString()
      Rebuilds the log entry in strict pipe-delimited format. This version is meant for machine reading and file output.
      Returns:
      the full log string in original format
